title: Connect a QQ official bot
intro: Connect a bot account from the QQ Open Platform. For OneBot accounts, use the QQ channel.
credentialHint: Find your AppID and AppSecret in the bot management console. A saved secret is masked. Edit it only to replace it.

modeHint.webhook: Use a public HTTPS address. QQ delivers events to your Anelf server.
modeHint.websocket: Connect from Anelf to the QQ gateway. Use this for local deployments or to send messages to guild channels.

eventHint: Select events your bot can access. Direct chats, group messages and guild mentions are selected by default.
invalidMask: Select at least one event or enter an event mask from 1 to 2147483647.
setupError: Could not refresh setup information. Any displayed status may be out of date.
missing: Enter both the AppID and AppSecret to connect.
startHint: Connecting enables this channel for future Anelf restarts.
saveStartupHint: Use Save settings only to turn off automatic startup. To end an active connection, use Stop on the channel card.
requested: Connection requested. See the current status below.
applyFailed: Could not apply settings. Check the connection status and try again.
publicHint: Enter your public domain, including a reverse proxy path prefix if needed. This input is only used to build the callback URL.
publicInvalid: Enter a public HTTPS address on port 80, 443, 8080 or 8443.
callback: Callback URL for the QQ Open Platform
callbackPath: Callback path (enter a public address to copy the full URL)
callbackHint: Save and connect first. Then paste the full URL in the QQ Open Platform event subscription page, select events and verify the address.
manualCopy: The callback URL is selected. Use your device’s copy command.
checkSaved: Apply your changes before checking the running bot.
checkAfterStart: Start the channel to check the QQ API, then send a message to verify event delivery.

field.require_mention: Require a mention in groups and guild channels to trigger reasoning
field.allowed_chats: Allowed conversation targets (comma-separated, blank allows all)
